title: Compliance export subscriptions with geo-partitioned attachments
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Large enterprise customers require a subscription-style compliance export service that produces signed PDF/CSV evidence bundles on a schedule, partitions attachments by data residency, honors tenant retention windows, and delivers to configurable sinks (SFTP, signed HTTP webhook, cloud object sync). Current ad-hoc export tooling is manual, region-agnostic, and lacks verifiable delivery manifests and per-tenant encryption key separation.

Goal: Build a subscriptions API and orchestration pipeline that allows tenants to register scheduled compliance exports with: (1) region-aware routing and storage (EU/US/APAC), (2) retention enforcement per tenant policy (auto-delete, TTL), (3) signed manifests and checksums for audit and chain-of-custody, (4) pluggable delivery backends (SFTP, cloud bucket push, webhook with cert pinning), and (5) monitoring + retry semantics with SLA-aware alerts.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement a custom PDF renderer for complex legal templates (separate design Epic). It will provide templating hooks and CSV flattening rules that are compatible with downstream legal formatting jobs.
acceptance_criteria: API: /v1/compliance_exports POST returns job id and validates residency and KMS key selection
Scheduling: exports can be scheduled daily/weekly/monthly with timezone-aware execution
Residency: attachments are stored in region-specific buckets and a manifest lists buckets with signed URLs or delivery receipts
Retention: tenant-level retention policy is enforced after export creation and reflected in manifest metadata
Delivery: at least two sinks implemented (SFTP push and signed webhook) with attestable delivery receipts
Security: per-tenant KMS key selection for encrypting archive artifacts; keys scoped by region
Observability: export job metrics (success/failures/duration), last-delivery timestamp, and a searchable audit trail in Console
Compliance: generated manifest contains SHA256 checksums and a server signature (KMS-based)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal + pilot tenants): implement subscription API, SFTP and webhook sinks, regional storage routing, KMS integration + manifest signing. Pilot with 3 existing compliance customers in US and EU. Phase 2 (wider rollout): add cloud-bucket push sink, retention enforcement automation, Console UX for subscriptions and job history, and on-demand replay. Gate: security review sign-off and pilot success metrics (>=95% on-time delivery for 7 days).
